title: 第九章 你不配！
novel_title: 宗门收徒，我能看见属性词条
content_zh:
楚星尘扶着厉行天将他放在了自己的木板床上。

    用自身灵力迅速感应了一圈厉行天现在体内的情况，楚星尘微微皱眉，因为厉行天现在的情况确实不太乐观。

    清风宗长老毕竟是金丹，即使留手想抓回去点天灯，但炼气期的厉行天也是扛不住这一击，此刻厉行天的五脏六腑都已受到重创。

    尤其经脉更是被强大灵力冲击，此刻他的经脉已经千疮百孔。

    不过看向厉行天的表情，却发现没有任何痛苦神色。

    不愧是重生者，真硬汉啊。

    不过这种情况只靠自身恢恢复估计够呛，得给他来一点精心炼制的疗伤灵药才是。

    “小子，挺能扛啊。”楚星尘夸赞一声，随后目光看向李应灵，“徒弟，起锅炼丹。”

    李应灵眼睛一亮，虽然她对吃师父丹药深恶痛绝，但并不妨碍她想看别人吃。

    她神色兴奋的迅速答应道：“好的，师父。”

    略带开心的走到锅边开始点火烧水。

    楚星尘翻看之前剩余的灵植，看一下是否还可以用来疗伤的。

    空间戒指之中正好还有几株可以用来疗伤的药草。

    再给未来徒弟炼一锅！让他吃完之后感恩戴德，纳头就拜。

    楚星尘将草药简单去掉根部后依旧简单粗暴的开始炼药。

    一锅清澈的水开始随着几根绿油油的灵植加入之后，就开始变得绿色浑浊起来。

    一股草药的臭味开始弥漫起来。

    不过李应灵没有任何不适，甚至还十分开心的看着逐渐浑浊的这锅药水。

    毕竟这次要喝的人不是她。

    到锅里的水减半时，楚星尘加入最后放的蓝月花。

    随着蓝色妖艳的花朵加入，这锅绿油油的水中，一股暗绿色的水咕噜咕噜冒起泡来。

    楚星尘满意的点了点头，随后直接大火收汁，将最后萃取的疗伤圣药用灵力包裹取了出来。

    李应灵看着这一枚比自己颜色更加逆天的药水滴，心中顿觉宽慰。

    她此刻相信师父之前不是为了整她了，而是铁锅炼丹就这样。

    师父说的果然没错，凡人话本里写的都不可信。

    修仙得自己经历才知道！

    此刻强忍疼痛的厉行天也撑起身子，看见了被灵力包裹的深绿色的水滴，看上去浑浊不堪。

    一股不好的念头缓缓升起……该不会这是拿来吞服的吧?

    楚星尘操控着药水到厉行天的嘴边笑道：“来！张嘴，我炼丹水准尚可，吞下这个保你平安无事。”
content_en:
Chu Xingchen supported Li Xingtian and placed him on his wooden bed.

Using his own spiritual power, he quickly sensed the situation in Li Xingtian's body. Chu Xingchen frowned slightly, because Li Xingtian's current situation was indeed not optimistic.

After all, the elder of the Qingfeng Sect was a golden elixir. Even if he tried to grab it back and light the sky lantern, Li Xingtian, who was in the Qi refining stage, could not withstand the blow. At this moment, Li Xingtian's internal organs had been severely damaged.

Especially his meridians were hit by powerful spiritual power. At this moment, his meridians were riddled with holes.

But looking at Li Xingtian's expression, he found that there was no sign of pain.

As expected of a reborn person, what a tough guy.

However, in this situation, it would be too difficult to just rely on oneself to recover, so he would need to be given some carefully refined healing elixir.

"Boy, you can carry it very well." Chu Xingchen praised, then looked at Li Yingling, "Apprentice, start making elixirs."

Li Yingling's eyes lit up. Although she hated taking her master's pills, it didn't stop her from wanting to watch others take them.

She looked excited and quickly agreed: "Okay, Master."

He walked to the pot with some joy and started to light the fire to boil the water.

Chu Xingchen looked through the remaining spiritual plants to see if they could still be used to heal injuries.

There happened to be a few herbs in the space ring that could be used for healing.

Make another pot for the future apprentice!Let him express his gratitude after eating, and then bow his head after receiving the meal.

Chu Xingchen simply removed the roots of the herbs and then started to refine the medicine simply and roughly.

A pot of clear water began to turn green and turbid after a few green spiritual plants were added.

A smell of herbal medicine began to permeate the air.

However, Li Yingling didn't feel any discomfort, and even looked at the pot of potion that was getting cloudy with great joy.

After all, she is not the one who wants to drink this time.

When the water in the pot was reduced by half, Chu Xingchen added the last blue moon flower.

With the addition of the charming blue flowers, a stream of dark green water bubbled up in the pot of green water.

Chu Xingchen nodded with satisfaction, then directly burned the juice to collect the juice, and took out the last extracted healing medicine wrapped in spiritual power.

Li Yingling felt relieved as she looked at this drop of potion, whose color was even more outrageous than her own.

She now believed that the master was not trying to punish her before, but that the iron pot was used to make elixirs.

What the master said is indeed true, nothing written in a mortal's book of words can be trusted.

You have to experience yourself to know how to cultivate immortality!

Li Xingtian, who was holding back the pain at this moment, also stood up and saw the dark green water droplets wrapped in spiritual power, which looked turbid.

A bad thought slowly arises... Could it be that this is meant to be swallowed?

Chu Xingchen manipulated the potion to Li Xingtian's mouth and smiled: "Come on! Open your mouth. My alchemy skills are quite good. Swallow this to keep you safe."
